blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lopez-led First Gen has secured a major supply deal, with 189 Jollibee Foods Corp. (JFC) outlets shifting to renewable energy. In a statement over the weekend, First Gen said it had secured a series of power supply contracts to energize Jollibee-owned stores. READ: First Gen sets P41.7B for projects The government’s retail aggregation program (RAP) enabled households and smaller consumers in a shared area to consolidate their demand and meet the threshold for deals with the Jollibee Group. In addition, stores covered by the agreements include outlets under the Jollibee, Greenwich, Chowking, Red Ribbon, Burger King and Panda Express […]...
